about_the_game:
Decay of Worlds

A turn-based fantasy defense game with RPG elements

The world is crumbling — and you are its last line of defense. Decay of Worlds blends tactical depth with meaningful choices. Deploy defensive units, unleash powerful magic, and lead a group of unique heroes through dark, perilous missions.

🗺️ Explore missions filled with unique challenges

  • Each mission introduces new enemy types, terrain effects, and tactical decisions.

  • Heroes have individual abilities that can turn the tide of battle.

  • At the end of every wave, make choices that shape future events.

🎲 Spend Fate Points to manage your resources strategically

  • Invest in magic, skills, or unit upgrades.

  • Adjust your strategy before each wave — adaptability is key to survival.

🛡️ Build your defense with tactical precision

  • Combine melee fighters, ranged units, and support roles for maximum effectiveness.

  • Enemies attack from up to two directions, forcing constant rethinking of your strategy.

  • Use abilities like scouts or buffs to prepare for the next wave.

🔥 Master elemental magic in combat

  • Fire: Deals damage over time.

  • Ice: Slows enemies and reduces their attack speed.

  • Air: Inflicts direct magic damage.

  • Earth: Lowers the damage enemies deal.

📜 Make impactful decisions

  • Respond to events with multiple-choice outcomes.

  • Discover hidden objects and relics that empower your heroes.

Decay of Worlds offers deep strategy, dark fantasy atmosphere, and a world on the brink of collapse. Will your defenses hold?
